login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to set a new one.

home.soonTitle: Vehicles and work orders are next
home.soonBody: This is an early version. For now you can manage staff, change your settings and test the camera scanner.

staff.title: Staff
staff.added: Account for {name} created. Give them the username and password.
staff.usernameHint: Used to sign in. 3–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

roleHint.owner: Sees everything, including money, and manages staff.
roleHint.mechanic: Works with vehicles, work orders and parts. No financial data.

staff.initialPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it later.
staff.selfHint: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.
staff.resetPasswordHint: Use this if they forgot their password. They will be signed out on all devices.
staff.passwordSet: New password set. Give it to them in person.
staff.deactivateHint: A deactivated person cannot sign in. Their work history stays.

account.title: Account
account.passwordSignsOut: Other devices where you are signed in will be signed out.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

scanner.title: Scanner test
scanner.intro: Point the camera at a barcode or QR code to check that scanning works on this phone.

errors.insecure: The camera only works over HTTPS. Open the app through its https:// address.
errors.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
errors.noCamera: No camera found on this device.
errors.generic: Could not start the camera. Close other apps that use it and try again.
errors.engine: The scanner could not start in this browser. Try the latest Chrome or Safari.

errors.network_error: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
errors.server_unavailable: The server is not responding. Try again in a minute.
errors.internal: Server error. Try again; if it repeats, tell the owner.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Only the owner can do this.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.

too_many_attempts_wait.one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {count} minute.
too_many_attempts_wait.other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {count} minutes.

errors.invalid_username: Username must be 3–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.password_too_short: Password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.password_too_long: Password is too long. Use at most 256 characters.
errors.invalid_locale: Choose a language from the list.
errors.invalid_role: Choose a role from the list.
errors.username_taken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.
errors.passwords_do_not_match: The new passwords do not match.
